ordering between the events. Give evidence to support your conclusions.

The expected ordering is:

proposal B_v with parent QC_(v-1)
-> replica receives the proposal
-> process the attached parent QC_(v-1)
-> possible HighQC update / advance into view v
-> verify the proposal
-> vote for B_v
-> receive, verify, and collect votes for B_v
-> enough valid and distinct votes form QC_v
-> process the new-view event carrying QC_v
-> update HighQC / advance to view v+1
-> next leader proposes B_(v+1) carrying QC_v

The system has the following relationships between the events:

- A proposal B_v carries a QC for its parent block.
- A replica processes the attached parent QC before voting on the current
  proposal.
- A replica can vote after receiving and validating a proposal.
- A CollectVote event means that a vote message was received, but the vote
  still needs to be verified before it can contribute to a quorum.
- Enough valid and distinct votes for the same proposal can form a new QC.
- A new QC can update the HighQC and contribute to advancing the protocol to
  the next view.
- The next proposal can extend the block certified by the new QC.
- If normal QC-driven progress does not occur, timeout events can contribute
  to a view change.
- Commit and DECIDE events depend on the progression of certified blocks across
  consecutive views.
